title: Lockout/Tagout Permit
name: Lockout/Tagout Permit
description: Permit for isolating plant and equipment from all hazardous energy sources before maintenance, cleaning, inspection or repair.

fields.label: Plant / Equipment ID or Tag Number
RAMS / Safe System of Work Reference

sections.title: ENERGY SOURCE IDENTIFICATION
items: All hazardous energy sources have been identified before isolation
Electrical supplies including secondary, standby and control supplies have been considered
Hydraulic and pneumatic pressure sources have been identified
Mechanical, gravity and stored energy hazards have been identified
Steam, gas, process, chemical and thermal energy sources have been considered
Manufacturer information, drawings or isolation procedures have been checked where available

fields.label: Secondary / Backup Systems and Remote Starts

sections.title: ISOLATION REGISTER
items: Equipment has been stopped using the normal shutdown procedure
Each isolation device has been positively identified and operated
Isolation devices have been secured against inadvertent reconnection
Personal locks and warning tags have been applied where required
Pressurised systems have been vented, drained or otherwise made safe
Stored mechanical energy has been released, restrained or securely blocked
Parts that could fall or move have been mechanically supported
Hot components have been allowed to cool where necessary
Group isolation / lockbox arrangements are in place where more than one worker is protected

fields.label: Isolation Points Register
fields.placeholder: List each isolator, breaker, valve, fuse, blank/spade or other isolation point and its location

fields.label: Lock / Tag Numbers and Owners
fields.placeholder: Record each personal or system lock/tag number and who applied it

sections.title: ZERO-ENERGY VERIFICATION
items: A zero-energy state has been independently verified before work starts
A start / try test has been completed where safe and appropriate
Electrical conductors have been proved dead using suitable test equipment where applicable
Electrical test equipment has been proved before and after the test where applicable
Pressure gauges, drains or vents confirm pressure has been safely removed where applicable
Potential movement has been checked and blocked or restrained where applicable
The work team has been briefed on the isolation boundary and prohibited actions

fields.label: Electrical / Test Instrument ID and Calibration Reference
Work Team Briefing / Toolbox Talk Reference

sections.title: WORK, HANDOVER AND SUSPENSION
items: Permit and isolation boundaries are understood by everyone working under the permit
Isolation controls will not be altered without formal authorisation
Shift handover will include the isolation status, outstanding work and permit conditions
If work is suspended the plant will remain in a safe isolated state
Any change in scope, plant condition or isolation arrangement will trigger permit review or cancellation

fields.label: Other Permits / SIMOPS Affecting This Isolation

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT AND RETURN TO SERVICE
items: Work is complete and all workers, tools and temporary equipment are clear
Guards, covers, interlocks and safety devices have been reinstated
Each personal lock has been removed by the person who applied it, or an authorised exception procedure has been followed
Affected persons have been informed before energy is restored
The area has been checked before re-energisation or repressurisation
Plant has been functionally tested where required and is safe to return to service
Any defects or restrictions have been recorded and communicated

sections.title: HAND-BACK AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Work has been completed or safely stopped
Plant and work area have been inspected
Temporary controls have been removed or formally handed over
Permit holder and issuer agree the equipment / area is ready for hand-back
